title: Unpack the Vault
subtitle: Reverse a mobile build to recover a hardcoded secret
summary: Planned lab: decompile a training APK, follow the crypto routine and recover a fictional licence token.
scenario: A synthetic Android build ships an obfuscated key. Decompile it, trace key derivation and validate the recovered token.
